experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8 and 9.9 for one context: seven outer words and eight members from the seed, the test of W, the 39 context lines; per member its walk of seven full blocks with the level-16 test of automaton (2); per live block 32 words of its list (224 lanes, spread evenly), run through the 256-lane bit-sliced kernel of the first section of proof.md (generated by the program), one batch per block; per passing lane, highest first, the completion of its word, the T1 and T2 tests and, for a nonzero test, the shortcut, the pre-check, the preflight, the joint screen and the joint solver, with the root predicate. In-run checks: those of proof.md 9.2, and on every word of index divisible by 3 the kernel's pass bit of each lane against the packed fill of the base entry and T1 = 0 on each lane the kernel did not pass. The run ends with an error if a trial finds a mismatch or if over the trials the passing lanes exceed 0.0165 of the sampled lanes by more than four binomial standard errors. No BLAKE3 library. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, t_hi = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not checked by the organizer: blocks, live, lanes, batches (256-lane batches), e_lanes (passing lanes of the prefilter), passes, prechecked, solver_calls, roots, certified, units, solver_units, checks, mismatches, halted, live_steps. Expected per trial: 56 blocks, about 4 live, about 880 lanes in about 4 batches, about 14 passing lanes (0.0158 of the lanes), 3 passes; mismatches and halted 0. The run is not evidence of attack cost and does not measure the pass share to the precision of the premise H_PF (lane). The program differs from that of the base entry (SHA-256 3a959e502429dbd00d4f3b26bec886af7c480debd37eac58ccf52d1de2ad25ca) in the word loop, its charges and the asserted figures.
